thread:
elena: FYI Helix sent a follow-up SQ. They want: KMS envelope proof for tenant keys, RBAC change diffs for infra service accounts (90d), sample audit-log export with retention metadata, and our customer-facing vuln-triage summary.
pranav: Got it. Do they need raw logs or a redacted bundle?
elena: Redacted bundle with mapping file. Also they asked for a short notes doc explaining our key-wrap and rotation model.
taylor: I can do the RBAC diffs. Plan: pull admin audit logs, filter for serviceAccount principals, then produce before/after binding snippets.
sam: I’ll collect KMS rotation events + CloudTrail/Cloud Audit logs and make a CSV: key_alias, key_type, first_created, last_rotated_by, last_rotated_ts. Will redact tenant identifiers.
elena: Please ensure we include HSM proofs for on-prem HSM customers: attestation entries and rotation approvals.
pranav: For the audit export they want to verify retention periods. We should include a manifest that cites retention_policy_id and retention_days for the log bucket.
taylor: Quick command I’ll run (GCP):
```
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"serviceAccount" AND (protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" OR protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy")' --freshness=90d --format=json > /tmp/helix/iam_admin_90d.json
```
sam: For AWS KMS rotation: extract CloudTrail entries where eventName=RotateKey or UpdateKeyDescription and map kmsKeyId -> userIdentity.
elena: Also include a short blurb on isolation: we never share KV cache or ephemeral storage across tenants; routing fallbacks maintain per-tenant workspace. Add a snippet from routing_policy that shows isolation stanza.
pranav: They also asked about vulnerability handling when a customer-facing incident occurs. Provide the high-level triage timeline and an anonymized example postmortem. Keep internal ticket IDs out.
taylor: I'll include diffs for any role grants that expanded privileges (show JSON diff). If a grant is large, summarize top 3 roles added and sample principals.
sam: Uploaded preliminary CSV to /tmp/helix_evidence/key_rotation.csv (redacted). Sample: "kms-abc123,aws-kms,2022-04-01,ops-admin@example.com,2026-01-30T03:12:00Z" but tenant token replaced with cust-XXXX.
elena: Good. Please do not upload until we run PII checklist. sec-bot will create the ticket.
sec-bot: Created SEC-2024: "Helix SQ evidence bundle" assigned to @elena,@taylor,@sam,@pranav. Due 2026-03-02 18:00 UTC.
pranav: I'll prepare manifest.md mapping files to SQ questions and a short README describing redaction rules. We'll store in s3://redwood-sec-share/helix-1787654321/.
taylor: One more item: Helix asked how our canary/fallback model handles secrets in transit. Add statement: ephemeral model containers do not persist tenant data, and network egress is blocked except to approved telemetry endpoints.
elena: Good. Action items: Taylor (RBAC diffs + manifest snippets), Sam (KMS rotation CSV + audit log samples), Pranav (README + vuln-triage summary + postmortem template). I'll review and request upload.
sam: ETA for my bits: 4 hours.
taylor: RBAC export starting now, should finish in ~90m. Will post scrubbed sample here.
pranav: I’ll draft the postmortem template tonight and share tomorrow AM.
elena: Remember to sign files with the evidence signing process and set presigned URLs to expire in 7 days. Use the internal checksum routine before upload.
sec-bot: Reminder: run redaction checklist -> https://internal.redwood/sec/redaction-checklist.
elena: Thanks all. If Helix requests a live proof, offer a 20-30m session with read-only log viewer. We'll include that in the README as an option.
pranav: Noted; will add scheduling note.
sec-bot: SEC-2024 status updated -> in progress.
